artifact_binding.why: A gate decision that names its artifact by a version STRING cannot detect the artifact changing underneath it. The sibling POSED audit's most serious finding was exactly this: three approved artifacts were edited after approval and nothing noticed for sixteen days, because hash-binding only detects drift when something asks. Release lint check 14 asks, on every push.
artifact_binding.on_mismatch: The ledger changed after the faculty decided on it. Re-gate the affected rows or record an amendment; do NOT silently re-stamp the hash.
